summary: Frontend-only E2E check of the Gate-4 QA Nov sprint fixes on https://genie-pos-front-2--37t4uxmo.preview.emergentagent.com (the URL from frontend/.env), logged in as owner@cafe103.com against preprod. PASS: login and logo (BUG-693), BUG-685, BUG-695, BUG-697, BUG-698, BUG-700 and BUG-691 (only checked against empty data). BUG-686 passes in a limited sense: cafe103 has 0 running orders, so a flash to 0 could not be seen, but the new guard log fired on every login. Found one new keyboard regression from the BUG-695 fix, plus a few minor issues. One login hit a transient preprod ERR_CONNECTION_RESET on Products; clicking Retry recovered it.

minor.issue: One login attempt failed at the Products step with net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET ('Cannot reach server'). 'Retry Failed' recovered it. External, flaky.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard users cannot open the inner 'Cancellation Report' link. If you focus audit-card1-link and press Enter, the keydown event bubbles up to the parent div role=button. That onKeyDown calls e.preventDefault(), which cancels the button's native click, and then toggleCard('card1') runs. Result: the card toggles and there is no navigation. Reproduced: the URL stayed on /audit-log and the card expanded. Fix: in the div onKeyDown add `if (e.target !== e.currentTarget) return;`, or stop keydown propagation on the link.

ui_bugs.component: Insights Dashboard / Cancellations presets (same class as BUG-697)
ui_bugs.issue: These pages still hard-code the highlighted preset. With a shared FY range, DashboardMockup showed 'Today' highlighted (useState('Today') at L67). With a shared Today range, CancellationsMockup showed '7D' highlighted. The highlighted chip does not match the inherited range. Reuse the matchPreset logic.

integration_issues.issue: The 'mount-or-auth' POS fetch is aborted on every login. The interval effect depends on pollOnce, whose deps (permissions, reconcile, addOrder) change identity right after login. The effect cleanup aborts the in-flight request, and the re-run is skipped as 'in-flight' because isPollingRef is still true. So the first reconcile never runs at login; it only runs on the next interval tick. The new guard prevents the wipe, but the cause is still there. Also, a rejected POS fetch under Promise.allSettled resets failureCountRef to 0, so backoff never applies to POS failures.

issues: A 'New version available — Update now' toast stays at bottom center on every screen and covers content. This is an environment artifact but should be checked.

action_items: Fix the Card 1 header onKeyDown so key events coming from child elements (the Cancellation Report link) are ignored: check e.target === e.currentTarget.
Optional: stabilise the pollOnce deps (or don't abort/skip on deps change) so the login mount poll actually reconciles, and count rejected POS fetches toward backoff.
Optional: apply the matchPreset highlight logic to the other Insights pages (DashboardMockup, CancellationsMockup) that inherit the shared range.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditLogMockup.jsx L376: role=button div onKeyDown should guard e.target !== e.currentTarget (keyboard regression).
useOrderPollingReconciliation.js L321/L347: pollOnce deps cause effect teardown and abort of the mount fetch on login; the 'skip in-flight' then suppresses the re-kick.
useOrderPollingReconciliation.js L306: failureCountRef is reset to 0 even when posResult is rejected, so backoff is bypassed.
AuditLogMockup.jsx: at 1,000+ lines it is above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting RiskBar, DrillDownTable and the cards into separate files.
